svg.title: Guteneo runtime and provider trust boundaries
svg.desc: Clients reach the shared domain service through Workers. D1, private R2, queues and private validation are inside the Cloudflare boundary. Fax, postal and email providers are outside it. Provider events return through the domain service. This is implementation architecture, not live qualification or a residency guarantee.
